title: E2E.Adversarial.Par3.Length.Elimination.2026-TESTGRP
description: The PAR3 twin of adv-par2-length-elimination: a par3cmdline set with one recovery block over thirty-two described files, beside thirty-one obfuscated members of their lengths whose bytes match nothing. Length matching settles without repeating its rejections; one block rebuilds none of it, so the set rules the repair impossible and the job fails for it, publishing nothing.
